Package com.irurueta.geometry.io

Class PLYTestFileBuilder

java.lang.Object
com.irurueta.geometry.io.PLYTestFileBuilder
final class PLYTestFileBuilder extends Object
Test helper that programmatically generates small PLY files (ASCII, binary little endian or binary big endian) so that every data type, storage mode and face layout can be exercised without committing binaries.
